tool.name: LaunchGUI
tool.summary: Open the SGTool window: the multi-tab interface of the SGTool QGIS plugin, running beside ArcGIS Pro, with live preview of the filters.
tool.usage:
The window runs as a separate program using the active ArcGIS Pro Python environment; run Set Up Python Environment first if packages are missing.

Results are written beside the input grid; run Add SGTool Outputs to Map to load them.
